result.topic_en: For a spherical triangle with angles A, B, C and sides a, b, c, the page tabulates six auxiliary plane triangles, giving each one's angles and the quantities proportional to its opposite sides, expressed in half-angles and half-sides.
result.transcription:
Sphaerisches Dreieck
Winkel   Seiten
$A$   $a$
$B$   $b$
$C$   $c$
Ebne Dreiecke

$A$ | $\sin\frac12 a$
$90^\circ-\frac12A+\frac12B-\frac12C$ | $\sin\frac12 b\cos\frac12 c$
$90-\frac12A-\frac12B+\frac12C$ | $\sin\frac12 c\cos\frac12 b$

$180-A$ | $\cos\frac12 a$
$\frac12A+\frac12B+\frac12C-90$ | $\sin\frac12 b\,.\,\sin\frac12 c$
$90+\frac12A-\frac12B-\frac12C$ | $\cos\frac12 b\,.\,\cos\frac12 c$

$B$ | $\sin\frac12 b$
$90-\frac12A-\frac12B+\frac12C$ | $\sin\frac12 a\cos\frac12 c$
$90+\frac12A-\frac12B-\frac12C$ | $\sin\frac12 c\cos\frac12 a$

$180-B$ | $\cos\frac12 b$
$\frac12A+\frac12B+\frac12C-90$ | $\sin\frac12 a\sin\frac12 c$
$90-\frac12A+\frac12B-\frac12C$ | $\cos\frac12 a\cos\frac12 c$

$C$ | $\sin\frac12 c$
$90-\frac12A+\frac12B-\frac12C$ | $\sin\frac12 b\cos\frac12 a$
$90+\frac12A-\frac12B-\frac12C$ | $\sin\frac12 a\cos\frac12 b$

$180-C$ | $\cos\frac12 c$
$\frac12A+\frac12B+\frac12C-90$ | $\sin\frac12 a\sin\frac12 b$
$90-\frac12A-\frac12B+\frac12C$ | $\cos\frac12 a\cos\frac12 b$

methods.what: Auxiliary plane triangle for angle A: its angles and the proportional opposite sides (law of sines), equivalent to the Gauss/Delambre analogies.
Auxiliary plane triangle with angle 180−A, involving the half spherical excess.
Auxiliary plane triangle for angle B.
Auxiliary plane triangle for angle C.
